acts.label: Prologue
acts.desc: Alex Blumberg talks with sailor Crevon Scott, who stocks vending machines on the Stennis.
acts.credits: By Alex Blumberg, Wendy Dorr, Ira Glass

acts.label: Act One
acts.desc: Aboard the USS Stennis, Ira Glass and Wendy Dorr talk with sailors about life on board. Off duty, people play video games, work out, or practice in one of the ship's many garage bands. Ira and Wendy also talk with sailors about how rumors travel on the ship — conversations that get back to the top brass, who give the producers heat for chasing salacious stories. Ira interviews the captain, James McDonell, and learns the ship is facing a fresh water shortage.

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: As pilots head to their planes for a mission, they explain how hard it is to land on an aircraft carrier. Wendy talks with sailors Cynthia and David, waiting for the 8PM movie to start, and she and Alex talk with sailors in the mess hall.
